name: register-review
title: Register review pack
for_each: select id,name from registers.registers order by name

sections.title: Records
sections.sql: select title,owner,status,due_on,review_due_on,blockers from registers.record_overview where register_id=$1 order by title

sections.title: Review actions
sections.sql: select a.title,a.issue,a.detail from registers.attention a join registers.records r on r.id=a.id where r.register_id=$1 order by a.title,a.issue

name: record-handover
title: Record handover
for_each: select id,title as name from registers.records order by title

sections.title: Record
sections.sql: select title,owner,status,due_on,values from registers.records where id=$1

sections.title: Dependencies
sections.sql: select d.title,d.owner,d.status,d.due_on from registers.links l join registers.records d on d.id=l.to_id where l.from_id=$1 and l.kind='depends-on' order by d.title

sections.title: Review evidence
sections.sql: select actor,note,reviewed_on,next_due from registers.reviews where record_id=$1 order by reviewed_on
